about.what: Pillow raster primitives captured for the Swift art port (Phase D). Each case draws `ops` in order onto an RGBA canvas of `size` cleared to (0,0,0,0) (or onto `canvas` when given) and records the result.
about.made_by: scratchpad/raster-cases.py (throwaway, not in the repo) run with the jeb-art venv; see desktop/tests/golden/README.md

ops.rectangle: ImageDraw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill); xy = [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive box (or [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]])
ops.line: ImageDraw.line(xy, fill=fill, width=width); xy = [x0, y0, x1, y1]
ops.point: ImageDraw.point(xy, fill=fill); xy = [x, y] or [[x, y], ...]
ops.ellipse: ImageDraw.ellipse(xy, fill=fill); xy = [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive bounding box
ops.arc: ImageDraw.arc(xy, start, end, fill=fill, width=width); degrees, 3 o'clock = 0, clockwise
ops.alpha_composite: Image.alpha_composite(src, dest); src = {size, rgba} and dest = [x, y]; off-canvas parts are clipped
ops.resize: Image.resize(size, Image.NEAREST) of the canvas; the result has the new size

about.fill: [r, g, b, a]; ImageDraw on an RGBA image writes the fill verbatim (no blending), so a = 0 erases
about.canvas: {size: [w, h], rgba: [row strings]} when the case starts from a non-blank image
about.result: {size, sha256, mask | rgba}: sha256 is over the RGBA bytes row-major 4 bytes/pixel (Image.tobytes()); mask rows use '#' for a pixel equal to the op's fill and '.' for (0,0,0,0); rgba rows are 8 hex chars (rrggbbaa) per pixel
about.error: the exception Pillow raised instead of a result (the port must never reach these inputs)
about.used_by_art: false marks cases whose shape mod/art/src never uses (recorded for completeness)
